instruction: Set up Thunderbird so that message tabs close automatically after deleting or moving their last message.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird to automatically close message tabs when the last message is deleted or moved. This is done by setting the mail.close_message_window.on_delete preference to true. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify this boolean preference value in the prefs.js file.
